title: Healthcare Patient Portal
description: A comprehensive healthcare patient portal designed to improve patient engagement and streamline medical communication. Features appointment scheduling, medical record access, and telemedicine capabilities with HIPAA compliance.

images.description: Patient dashboard providing quick access to upcoming appointments, recent test results, and important health notifications
Medical records interface with secure document viewing, download capabilities, and chronological health history timeline
Appointment scheduling system with calendar integration, provider selection, and automated reminder notifications
Telemedicine video consultation interface with screen sharing, chat functionality, and secure communication features
